en.dr-ali-peiravi: 2-87 Muhammad ibn al-Hassan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Muhammad ibn al-Hassan al-Saffar quoted Al-Abbas ibn Ma’ruf, on the authority of Al-Hassan ibn Ali ibn Faz’zal, on the authority of Zarif ibn Nasih, on the authority of Abil Hassain, “I heard Aba Abdullah as-Sadiq (MGB) say that
the Prophet of God (MGB) was questioned about the Hour and the Prophet (MGB) said, ‘It is when the people believe in astrology and deny destiny.’”
